blocks.html: ROBINSONS GALLERIA CEBU OPENS WITH A SLEW OF CELEBRITY PERFORMANCES

Cebuanos get another reason to celebrate these holidays as after much anticipation, Robinsons Galleria Cebu finally opens its gates this December 10. Poised to become Cebu’s top-of-the-line hub for leisure and dining, Robinsons Galleria Cebu whips up only the best entertainment lineup for its series of upcoming celebrations.

Welcoming Cebuanos on the Grand Opening are actress du jour and Robinsons Land Corporation’s ambassadress Maja Salvador, Asia’s Nightingale Lani Misalucha and Asia’s Got Talent Grand Winner El Gamma Penumbra each to stage their trademark acts. Not to be missed as well are performances from Gawad Urian award-winning actor Paulo Avelino on December 11; and Xian Lim on December 12, where fans can win a chance to get up close and personal with the Filipino-Chinese model-actor through an Instagram contest. All show starts at 5pm. Shoppers who are coming with their children on December 13 need not worry as something is served up for the little ones: Kids and their parents get to interact with Kevin, Stuart and Bob of the adorable Minions.

In true first class style, there will also be free shuttle rides on the day of the Grand Opening. The two 30-seater coasters will be serving 2 routes. Shuttle Service 1 will serve ferry passengers arriving and departing at Cebu Port, taking them from Piers 1-4 to the mall and vice versa while Shuttle Service 2 will take passengers from Robinsons Galleria Cebu to Carreta, Mango Avenue, Fuente, Capitol, Escario, Gorordo Avenue and vice versa. The free shuttle service will be made available regularly by Robinsons Galleria Cebu.
